messages.subject: Zero-inflated Poisson type 2
parts:
Dear all,

Reading the documentation of zero inflated distribution I came across to an extension called Zero-inflated Poisson, type 2. Where the probability of zero is a function of the mean with an hyper parameter alpha.

I want a model where my probability of zero varies on time, so if my mean, well the log of it, has time random effect would the probability of zero also depend on time?

Could I have a time random effect for p in different way? I am thinking a about a time series of a disease count, and for some periods there are no cases, and sometimes there are some outbreaks.

Best,
Leo Bastos
Senior researcher at Oswaldo Cruz Foundation, Brazil
